title: Google Calendar integration
description: Live free/busy availability and automatic interview event management on Google Calendar, with per-interviewer OAuth and revocable, scoped access.

faq.q: What Google Calendar access does Cadence use?
faq.a: Each interviewer authorises their own connection via Google OAuth. Cadence reads free/busy availability and manages only the interview events it creates; tokens are encrypted at rest and revocable at any time.

faq.q: What happens if a Google connection expires?
faq.a: Cadence detects the failed refresh, marks the connection as needing attention, and asks the interviewer to reconnect before it affects a booking.
